description: A RecyclerView Adapter for displaying notes in a list, handling efficient updates with DiffUtil, payloads for partial updates, and managing different view types and modes.

classes.name: NoteRecyclerAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView.Adapter implementation managing note items, supporting diffing, payloads, and different display modes.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new NoteViewHolder, inflating layout and initializing view pools.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Overloaded method binding data to view holder, with or without payloads for partial updates.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns the unique ID of an item at a given position.

methods.name: submitList
methods.description: Sets internal item lists and updates the adapter's data source, filtering hidden notes if necessary.
